body:
# 🃏 Blackjack — A Hypixel Party Game

Turn your Hypixel party chat into a Blackjack table! This client-side mod lets you host fully functional Blackjack games directly through party chat — no external tools, no setup, just type `!create` and play.

---

## How It Works

One player loads the mod and hosts the game. Everyone else in the party can join and play using simple chat commands — **they don't need the mod installed**.

---

## Commands

### Party Chat Commands
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `!create` | Start a new game lobby (host only) |
| `!start` | Deal the cards and begin the round (host only) |
| `!join` | Join the current lobby |
| `!hit` | Draw another card |
| `!stand` | Hold your current hand |
| `!stats` | View your personal win/loss/tie record |
| `!rules` | Display the game rules |
| `!blackjack` | List all available commands |
| `!end` | End the current game (host only) |
| `!skip <player>` | Skip a player's turn (host only) |

### Minecraft Commands
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/blackjack toggle` | Enable or disable the mod |
| `/blackjack discord` | Show the Discord invite link |

---

## Features

- 🎮 **Full Blackjack logic** — 6-deck shoe, proper Ace handling (1 or 11), dealer hits on 16 and below
- 👥 **Up to 7 players** per game
- 📊 **Persistent stats** — wins, losses, and ties are saved locally across sessions
- 🔒 **Host-only controls** — only the player who typed `!create` can start, end, or skip turns
- 🤝 **Multi-host conflict prevention** — if another player with the mod starts a game, your mod automatically disables itself to avoid duplicate responses, with a clear notification and easy re-enable via `/blackjack toggle`
- 💬 **No rank conflicts** — works with all Hypixel ranks (`[VIP]`, `[MVP++]`, etc.)

---

## Important
> ⚠️ Use at your own risk as it is technically a (chat) macro.

> ⚠️ According to Hypixel's Terms of Service, it is **not allowed to play for in-game items or coins**. This mod is purely for fun and social entertainment.

---

## Stats Storage

Stats are saved at:
`.minecraft/config/blackjack/blackjack_stats.json`
